snippet.title: Gameplay from our NNGC Demo of Century of Steam! Part 1
snippet.description:
We know not everyone could make it out to Denver for NNGC, so here's our president Mark playing through the demo!
There's a lot going on in the Demo, so we'll show more gameplay footage in part 2, which is currently on Patreon for early viewers!
